title: SHARDOR Espresso Machine 20 Bar, Professional Espresso Machine with Milk Frother and Touchscreen, Expresso Coffee Machines with Adjustable Temperature,for Cappuccino, Latte, Stainless Steel, Silver

reviews.title: Café-quality coffee at home—super easy to use
reviews.body: I was worried it would be complicated, but I had it set up in 5 minutes. The 20 bars of pressure really make a difference: the espresso comes out with thick crema and good body. The milk frother heats up quickly and creates microfoam for cappuccinos without any issues. It’s compact, doesn't make much noise, and heats up in less than a minute. For the price, it’s the best purchase I’ve made to stop buying coffee out. 100% recommended.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 14, 2026
reviews.author: Cristina trujillo

reviews.title: Excellent Espresso Machine.
reviews.body: This replaced my janky old Mr. Coffee machine that used only steam pressure to push the water through grounds.This Shardor machine cost 90$ USD and is amazing for the price.  I could describe how janky my old machine was, but suffice to say this Shardor puts out a triple espresso, my favorite, with only 2/3 (13g instead of 21) of the coffee beans the old one required and with a righteous creme head that lasts at least as long as it takes me to drink to coffee, so at least 5-7 minutes.  Lots of adjustments for custom brew, 3 temp settings, programmable pour sizes.  I don't use the steam wand but it worked well when I cleaned it out for 1st use.  Coffee tastes just like a pro barista made it.  Unit seems sturdy after a couple of months of use a couple of times a day.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 17, 2026
reviews.author: Charles K Mount

reviews.title: Can make better a cappuccino better than most coffee shops
reviews.body: We love cappuccinos and it’s ridiculous how much is charged for one in the coffee shops especially when it’s not always made right.Easy to operate (though this may be because I’ve had other machines in my life so no real learning curve).  Steamer works well for making nice thick foam that looks like whipped cream.  Happy with purchase. It seems well made so hopefully it will give us no trouble in the coming years.

reviews.title: Not bad - great for simple
reviews.body: It’s a great starter. I just can’t get the plastic smell out of the milk steamer so I don’t use it. I’ve tried everything recommended. Water capacity is good, it works great, makes great espresso, not too loud but does make a noise. I haven’t cleaned the inside yet but the water basin is easy to remove and the drip tray as well. Not bad for $100

features: Professional 20 Bar Pressure System: This semi-automatic espresso maker has a 20-bar pump and a powerful 1350W motor, ensuring rich coffee flavor and aroma. You can make cappuccinos, lattes, and flat whites at home or in the office with this stainless steel machine.

One-Touch Touchscreen：LED display with options for single or double cups, manual mode to customize coffee strength, one-touch descaling, temperature control, one-touch steam, and auto shutoff after 15 minutes of inactivity.

Professional Steam Wand：Our espresso machine with a milk frother has a powerful steam wand that creates creamy, rich foam for better coffee flavor and latte art. Ideal for lattes, cappuccinos, and macchiatos, this compact machine helps you make barista-quality drinks at home.
NTC Precision Temperature Control：With three temperature settings, you can fully control your coffee experience by adjusting the extraction temperature to suit your taste.

Compact Stainless Steel Design：This espresso machine fits perfectly in any kitchen. The 45 oz removable water tank lets you brew several cups without refilling, and the drip tray is easy to clean. Includes everything you need to get started: Espresso Machine, 45 oz Water Tank, Single & Double Cup Filters, Portafilter, Tamper with Spoon, and Instruction Manual.

Q: I’ve been using the machine for a while and now it’s not brewing coffee. Is it broken? A: No, it’s not broken. It just needs to be descaled. Please refer to the user manual for descaling instructions, and the machine will work normally again.
Tips: If you wish to warm your cup on top of the machine, please make sure the cup is completely dry before placing it!
